# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_REVERSION_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

If the market opens outside the opening range and then revisits VWAP with a rejecting price action (wick longer than body), the tendency to revert to the mean offers a short edge. This setup captures mean reversion after an initial OR breach, exploiting the institutional tendency to defend VWAP as a fair value reference.

## Mechanism

Define opening range (OR) as high/low of first 5‑minute bar after 09:30 ET. If price at 09:35 is above OR high or below OR low, then monitor for the first 1‑minute bar after 09:45 that touches VWAP (price crosses VWAP) and shows a wick‑to‑body ratio >0.6 (wick longer than body) in the direction opposite the initial OR breach; enter short at the close of that bar. Exit: Stop placed above the high of the reversal candle for short (chart‑stop), target at 1×R to the OR opposite side, with a runner that trails 20% of the highest high since entry if price moves favorably. Regime filter: only active when VIX is 12‑22 and first 30‑minute range <0.5% of SPY price; disabled during FOMC/earnings windows.
